summary.headline: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 7% to Rs 81.43 crore and PAT fell 16% to Rs 23.94 crore on weak wind availability.
summary.overview: Revenue from operations was Rs 81.43 crore and EBITDA Rs 60.01 crore, down 7% and 9% YoY, as a delayed monsoon muted early wind season output. New capacity (9.9 MW wind commissioned late FY26 and beginning Q1, plus 7 MW solar from December 2025) partly offset the shortfall. PAT fell 16% to Rs 23.94 crore on lower interest income after rights issue proceeds were deployed into projects, and higher depreciation. Management expects Q2 to be better than Q1, with wind availability recovering, and guided FY27 revenue and EBITDA to be equal to or better than FY26. Growth beyond the current pipeline remains dependent on undisclosed funding and acquisition triggers.

segments.name: Wind (operating fleet)
segments.commentary: Q1 wind output was muted by delayed monsoon and a weak first part of the wind season; new 9.9 MW wind capacity partly offset the shortfall. Turbine performance described as nominal with no significant availability issues.

segments.name: Solar (C&I)
segments.commentary: 7 MW solar plant commissioned December 2025 and contributing. A further 17.6 MW solar is under implementation; management targets commissioning by end September 2026 with the 7.8 MW wind repowering.

segments.name: Netherlands holding entity / Croatia asset
segments.commentary: Liquidating a 100% step-down Netherlands subsidiary with no assets; the Croatia asset (about 10.5 MW) stays with the company. Related top-line about EUR 1 million per year (about Rs 9 crore).

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue and EBITDA guided to be equal to or better than FY26, with a higher bar contingent on the monsoon and wind; Q2 said to be better than Q1.
Margins expected to be sustained as O&M costs are largely fixed.
FY27 capacity additions: about 17.5 MW solar and 7.8 MW wind, plus 3.3 MW wind already added, totalling about 11 MW wind and about 15 MW solar this fiscal (per management).
Blended interest rate targeted at around 9% going forward, from 9.1% now; approaching IREDA for a further 15 bps reduction on the Beta loan.
FY28: 15-20 MW of repowered assets expected; broader capacity plan to be clearer by mid-Q3 FY27.

Promoter share pledge expected to be fully released by end of FY27 per CFO; full promoter loan final due September 2027 (the CFO said installments run to September 2027 and about 40% of the loan repaid).
capex_capacity: Commissioned 3.3 MW wind at start of Q1 FY27, following 6.6 MW at end of FY26 (9.9 MW incremental wind); 7 MW solar commissioned December 2025.

Under implementation: 17.6 MW (about 17.5 MW) greenfield solar and 7.8 MW wind repowering in Clarion (Tamil Nadu); both expected by end September 2026 after delays from a change of state government and approvals.
Next repowering phase: about 17.5 MW in Gamma next year, plus about 2.8 MW more at Clarion; first stage around 28 MW total repowering, selected on lowest-wind machines.
Potential for another 20-25 MW by leveraging existing assets; existing wind sites could host at least about 100 MW of hybrid solar, subject to land and Tamil Nadu hybrid policy notification.
Targets 1 GW total capacity (earlier 2028 target), with inorganic (mostly wind) and organic growth; no firm acquisition yet.
demand_pricing: Net PPA rate about Rs 4.75 per unit across corporate and government (Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu), net of transmission cost; solar differs.
Management says no material receivables above 90 days other than the Andhra Pradesh delayed-interest amount.
Industrial (group captive) customers must hold 26% equity in new projects, providing some funding.
Management says demand is not the constraint; funding is the constraint ('we need Vitamin M').
BESS currently not required in Tamil Nadu; battery storage regulation expected to be clarified within 2-3 months per management; future solar expected to include battery storage.

qa_highlights.question: Plan to reach 1 GW given the share price near Rs 10 and limited capital options?
qa_highlights.answer: Management says it is still working towards 1 GW, with brownfield and acquisition options; serious conversations did not proceed; expects something to move in FY27 but declined to give valuations or details.

qa_highlights.question: How does the current wind season compare with last year?
qa_highlights.answer: Q1 was significantly worse than last year; Q2 to date is matching last year's pace; the season is seen as similar to two years ago.

qa_highlights.question: Debt and interest guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: Interest about Rs 13-14 crore per quarter; blended rate 9.1%; about Rs 90-100 crore repayment this year, total debt about Rs 535 crore at year-end; new debt for repowering expected next year.

qa_highlights.question: Andhra Pradesh delayed interest receivable and provisioning?
qa_highlights.answer: About Rs 20 crore outstanding on delayed PPA interest; Rs 6.5 crore provided (about 30%); APERC non-functional, so recovery is pending.

qa_highlights.question: Can the company expand through debt alone, and how is capital being raised?
qa_highlights.answer: Only about 20-25 MW more can be done through leverage on existing assets; further growth needs equity; talks with PE investors and promoters are ongoing with no firm outcome.

qa_highlights.question: Is FY27 guidance conservative given capacity additions?
qa_highlights.answer: Management says guidance is conservative because of wind uncertainty; it expects to exceed FY26 thanks to added capacity, but by an amount dependent on the monsoon.

risks_watch: Wind dependence: Q1 volumes were weak, and FY27 top line depends on monsoon and wind; Q2 recovery is not yet proven.
Funding for 1 GW target remains unresolved; no firm equity, acquisition or partner announced, and the share price is near Rs 10.
Repowering and solar commissioning timelines have slipped (from June 30 to September 30, 2026) due to Tamil Nadu approvals.
Andhra Pradesh delayed-interest receivable of about Rs 20 crore, with Rs 6.5 crore provided; recovery depends on APERC becoming functional.
Promoter pledge release timing is unclear: earlier comments suggested full release by end FY27, while the CFO also cited September 2027 as the final loan due date.
Tamil Nadu battery and hybrid policy still pending, which affects economics of future solar and hybrid projects.
summary.management_tone: Cautious on near-term volumes and candid that growth is constrained by funding; confident on margins and on the 9.9 MW wind plus 7 MW solar adding to profits. Evasive on acquisitions, valuations and promoter funding, saying talks are ongoing without detail.

growth.why: FY27 revenue and EBITDA guided only to be equal to or better than FY26, explicitly contingent on monsoon and wind; backed by 9.9 MW wind already added and 17.5 MW solar plus 7.8 MW wind repowering due by end-September 2026 after delays, while Q1 revenue fell 7% on weak wind and funding is cited as the binding constraint.
